Package com.helix.core.cache.l4

Class L4RedisRuleCache

java.lang.Object
com.helix.core.cache.l4.L4RedisRuleCache
All Implemented Interfaces:
DistributedRuleCache, AutoCloseable
public class L4RedisRuleCache extends Object implements DistributedRuleCache
Enterprise L4 Distributed Rule Cache backed by Redis. Uses atomic Lua scripts for fetch-or-lock stampede protection and Pub/Sub invalidation. Degrades gracefully to in-memory fallback when Redis is unreachable.
